findings.rationale: The docstring claims this is 'the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for builtin command routing configuration. Config module should call this instead of maintaining separate hardcoded rules.' A repo-wide grep for `get_builtin_routing_rules` finds only its definition (query.rs:72) and its ToolCatalog wrapper (mod.rs:239) — zero callers in src/, bin/, or interfaces/. The live routing path builds builtin RoutingRuleConfig via crate::config::types::routing (builtin_rule(), rule_type 'command') and reads the resolved tool's routing_regex/routing_system_prompt/routing_capabilities directly in src/command/parser.rs:136-146. So the producer is fully implemented + tested, but the 'config module reads it' wire is severed and nothing has called it. No live caller => CUT (read-before-write), not CONNECT. The 'single source of truth' doc is aspirational and now drifts against routing.rs's hardcoded builtins.
findings.proposed_change: Delete ToolQuery::get_builtin_routing_rules (query.rs:72-92) and the ToolCatalog wrapper (mod.rs:239-242). If a builtin-routing source-of-truth is genuinely wanted, that is a separate CONNECT decision for the config module — but do not reconnect dead scaffolding.
findings.risk: Low. It is a pub method on a pub type, but the alephcore lib and aleph-server binary both grep clean. Its only live-ish value is the docstring promise, which has zero enforcement.
findings.verification: cargo check -p alephcore && cargo test -p alephcore --lib --no-run; grep -rn get_builtin_routing_rules src/ bin/ to confirm zero remaining references.

findings.rationale: Three never-produced/never-read enum variants, each a half-finished feature. ConflictResolution::NoConflict is unreachable (resolve_conflict always returns RenameNew/RenameExisting; the only match arm is the dead 'should not happen' arm at registry/conflict.rs:242). ToolCategory::GeneratedSkill is never constructed anywhere (a 'Skill Compiler' that never shipped; only display_name/icon arms reference it). DispatchMode (Direct vs AgentLoop) has zero external readers — to_prompt_line() ignores dispatch_mode and no prompt builder consumes it. All three are pub with #[non_exhaustive] and no external consumer => dead variants, not load-bearing wires.
findings.proposed_change: Remove ConflictResolution::NoConflict and its dead match arm (registry/conflict.rs:242-244 + types/conflict.rs:87-88 + the test at conflict.rs:367). Remove or #[doc(hidden)]-reserve ToolCategory::GeneratedSkill and DispatchMode (they are Serialize/Deserialize — check for any persisted discriminant before removing).
